query: What is the capital of Australia?
notes: Sanity check for the harness itself. Both variants are equally correct, equal-quality paraphrases with no freshness/price/relevance advantage, so a citation preference across the AB/BA swap would reveal position bias introduced by the harness rather than a content effect.

variantA.label: Equivalent answer 1
variantA.text: The capital of Australia is Canberra. It was purpose-built as the national capital and sits between Sydney and Melbourne, hosting Parliament and most of the country's federal government institutions.

variantB.label: Equivalent answer 2
variantB.text: Australia's capital is Canberra. Chosen as a compromise between Sydney and Melbourne, it was purpose-built to host Parliament and most of the nation's central federal government institutions today.
